entries.title: George Osborne's scheme was intended to ___.
entries.text: George Osborne's scheme was intended to ___. [A] motivate the unemployed to report voluntarily. 激励失业者主动报告。 [B] provide the unemployed with easier access to benefits. 让失业者更便捷地获取救济金。 [C] encourage jobseekers' active engagement in job seeking. [D] guarantee jobseekers' legitimate right to benefits. 保障求职者领取福利的合法权利。 答案 C George Osborne's scheme was intended to ___.乔治·奥斯本（ George Osborne ）的计划旨在___。 [A] motivate the unemployed to report voluntarily.激励失业者主动报告。 [B] provide the unemployed with easier access to benefits.让失业者更便捷地获取救济金。 [C] encourage jobseekers' active engagement in job seeking. [D] guarantee jobseekers' legitimate right to benefits.保障求职者领取福利的合法权利。 💡 考场思路首段：要求失业者带简历、注册在线求职、开始找工作才有资格领救济。目的就是"鼓励积极找工作"。 逐项分析 [A] 自愿报到 → 原文要求 weekly 强制报到，错； [B] 更容易拿救济 → 原文是加了条件、等7天，是更难拿； [C] 鼓励积极求职 → 正确，对应 start looking for work； [D] 保障救济权利 → 与原文"no entitlement"相反。 核心词汇 Chancellor of the Exchequer 财政大臣 eligible adj. 有资格的 dependency n. 依赖 subsidise v. 补贴 indulgent adj. 纵容的 claimant n. 申请人

entries.title: The phrase "to sign on" (Para. 2) most probably means ___.
entries.text: The phrase "to sign on" (Para. 2) most probably means ___. [A] to register for an allowance from the government. [B] to accept the government's restrictions on the allowance. 接受政府对津贴的限制。 [C] to check on the availability of jobs at the jobcentre. 查看就业中心职位的空缺情况。 [D] to attend a governmental job-training program. 参加政府就业培训项目。 答案 A The phrase "to sign on" (Para. 2) most probably means ___.短语“登录” （第2段）很可能意味着___。 [A] to register for an allowance from the government. [B] to accept the government's restrictions on the allowance.接受政府对津贴的限制。 [C] to check on the availability of jobs at the jobcentre.查看就业中心职位的空缺情况。 [D] to attend a governmental job-training program.参加政府就业培训项目。 💡 考场思路sign on 与 looking for work 对比："头几天应该用来找工作，而不是 sign on"——sign on 就是去登记领救济金。 逐项分析 [A] 登记领政府津贴 → 正确； [B] 接受政府限制 → 这不是 sign on 的含义； [C] 查询工作 → 与 looking for work 同义，不是对比项； [D] 参加培训 → 无中生有。

entries.title: What promoted the chancellor to develop his scheme?
entries.text: What promoted the chancellor to develop his scheme? [A] A desire to secure a better life for all. 一种为所有人争取更美好生活的愿望。 [B] An eagerness to protect the unemployed. 保护失业者的热忱。 [C] An urge to be generous to the claimants. 对申请者慷慨相助的冲动。 [D] A passion to ensure fairness for taxpayers. 答案 D What promoted the chancellor to develop his scheme?是什么促使财政大臣制定了他的计划？ [A] A desire to secure a better life for all.一种为所有人争取更美好生活的愿望。 [B] An eagerness to protect the unemployed.保护失业者的热忱。 [C] An urge to be generous to the claimants.对申请者慷慨相助的冲动。 [D] A passion to ensure fairness for taxpayers. 💡 考场思路第二段末："his zeal for 'fundamental fairness'—protecting the taxpayer, controlling spending"——动机是对纳税人公平的热忱。 逐项分析 [A] 为所有人更好生活 → 这是 Osborne 自我标榜，不是真正动机； [B] 保护失业者 → 与原文"最不慷慨的救济"相反； [C] 对申请人慷慨 → 与原文相反； [D] 对纳税人公平的热情 → 正确，对应 fundamental fairness / protecting taxpayer。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 3, being unemployed makes one feel ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 3, being unemployed makes one feel ___. [A] insulted. 受辱的；被冒犯的。 [B] uneasy. [C] enraged. 被激怒的。 [D] guilty. 有罪的；内疚的。 答案 B According to Paragraph 3, being unemployed makes one feel ___.根据第3段，失业会让人感到___。 [A] insulted.受辱的；被冒犯的。 [B] uneasy. [C] enraged.被激怒的。 [D] guilty.有罪的；内疚的。 💡 考场思路第三段：financially terrifying, psychologically embarrassing, not wanted, excluded——这些都是"不安/难堪"的情绪。uneasy 概括最准。 逐项分析 [A] 受侮辱 → 程度过重，原文是 embarrassing 不是 insulted； [B] 不安/不适 → 正确，概括 terrifying/embarrassing/excluded； [C] 暴怒 → 无中生有； [D] 内疚 → 与原文相反，失业者无错。

entries.title: To which of the following would the author most probably agree?
entries.text: To which of the following would the author most probably agree? [A] Unemployment benefits should not be made conditional. [B] The British welfare system indulges jobseekers' laziness. 英国福利制度纵容求职者的懒惰。 [C] The jobseekers' allowance has met their actual needs. 求职津贴满足了他们的实际需求。 [D] Osborne's reforms will reduce the risk of unemployment. 奥斯本的改革将降低失业风险。 答案 A To which of the following would the author most probably agree?作者最有可能同意以下哪项？ [A] Unemployment benefits should not be made conditional. [B] The British welfare system indulges jobseekers' laziness.英国福利制度纵容求职者的懒惰。 [C] The jobseekers' allowance has met their actual needs.求职津贴满足了他们的实际需求。 [D] Osborne's reforms will reduce the risk of unemployment.奥斯本的改革将降低失业风险。 💡 考场思路末段：英国福利原则已不再是"无条件领取救济"，作者用 "It is as though 20 years of reforms never happened" 讽刺 Osborne，暗示他反对把救济变成有条件的。 逐项分析 [A] 救济不应有附加条件 → 正确，作者批评 conditional on actively seeking a job； [B] 英国福利纵容懒惰 → 这是 Osborne 的观点，作者用反讽语气否定； [C] 津贴满足需求 → 与原文 least generous 相反； [D] 改革降低失业风险 → 无中生有。 核心词汇 entitlement n. 应得权利 instinct n. 本能 unconditional adj. 无条件的 fortnightly adv. 每两周地

entries.title: A lot of students take up law as their profession due to ___.
entries.text: A lot of students take up law as their profession due to ___. [A] the growing demand from clients. 客户日益增长的需求。 [B] the increasing pressure of inflation. 日益增长的通胀压力。 [C] the prospect of working in big firms. 在大型企业工作的前景。 [D] the attraction of financial rewards. 答案 D A lot of students take up law as their profession due to ___.由于___ ，许多学生以法律为职业。 [A] the growing demand from clients.客户日益增长的需求。 [B] the increasing pressure of inflation.日益增长的通胀压力。 [C] the prospect of working in big firms.在大型企业工作的前景。 [D] the attraction of financial rewards. 💡 考场思路第二段："The best lawyers made skyscrapers-full of money, tempting ever more students to pile into law schools"——最优秀律师赚大钱，吸引学生涌入法学院。 逐项分析 [A] 客户需求增长 → 未提及； [B] 通胀压力 → 原文 spending grew twice as fast as inflation 是支出增速，不是学生选法律的原因； [C] 进大所的前景 → 原文说 most graduates never get big-firm job； [D] 经济回报的吸引力 → 正确，对应 skyscrapers-full of money。 核心词汇 hostility n. 敌意 tort n. 侵权 excessive adj. 过度的 guild-like adj. 行会式的 liberalize v. 放开/自由化 conservative adj. 保守的

entries.title: Which of the following adds to the costs of legal education in most American sta
entries.text: Which of the following adds to the costs of legal education in most American states? [A] Higher tuition fees for undergraduate studies. 本科阶段更高的学费。 [B] Pursuing a bachelor's degree in another major. [C] Admissions approval from the bar association. 律师协会的准入批准。 [D] Receiving training by professional associations. 接受专业协会的培训。 答案 B Which of the following adds to the costs of legal education in most American states?以下哪项增加了大多数美国州的法律教育费用？ [A] Higher tuition fees for undergraduate studies.本科阶段更高的学费。 [B] Pursuing a bachelor's degree in another major. [C] Admissions approval from the bar association.律师协会的准入批准。 [D] Receiving training by professional associations.接受专业协会的培训。 💡 考场思路第三段：先读四年 unrelated subject 本科，再读三年法律——本科读不相关专业增加了时间和费用。 逐项分析 [A] 本科学费高 → 原文未提本科费高，而是多花了四年时间读无关专业； [B] 读另一个专业的本科 → 正确，a four-year undergraduate degree in some unrelated subject； [C] 律协批准入学 → 原文是 law schools 被授权，不是学生被批准； [D] 专业协会培训 → 无中生有。

entries.title: Hindrance to the reform of the legal system originates from ___.
entries.text: Hindrance to the reform of the legal system originates from ___. [A] non-professionals' sharp criticism. 非专业人士的尖锐批评。 [B] lawyers' and clients' strong resistance. 律师与客户的强烈抵制。 [C] the rigid bodies governing the profession. [D] the stern exam for would-be lawyers. 准律师面临的严格考试。 答案 C Hindrance to the reform of the legal system originates from ___.法律制度改革的障碍源于___。 [A] non-professionals' sharp criticism.非专业人士的尖锐批评。 [B] lawyers' and clients' strong resistance.律师与客户的强烈抵制。 [C] the rigid bodies governing the profession. [D] the stern exam for would-be lawyers.准律师面临的严格考试。 💡 考场思路第四段："the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them"——管理机构过于保守，即 rigid bodies。

entries.title: The guild-like ownership structure is considered "restrictive" partly because it
entries.text: The guild-like ownership structure is considered "restrictive" partly because it ___. [A] prevents lawyers from gaining due profits. 阻碍律师获得应得收益。 [B] keeps lawyers from holding law-firm shares. 阻止律师持有律所股份。 [C] aggravates the ethical situation in the trade. 加剧了行业内的伦理状况。 [D] bans outsiders' involvement in the profession. 答案 D The guild-like ownership structure is considered "restrictive" partly because it ___.公会式的所有权结构被认为是“限制性的” ，部分原因是它___。 [A] prevents lawyers from gaining due profits.阻碍律师获得应得收益。 [B] keeps lawyers from holding law-firm shares.阻止律师持有律所股份。 [C] aggravates the ethical situation in the trade.加剧了行业内的伦理状况。 [D] bans outsiders' involvement in the profession. 💡 考场思路第五段："non-lawyers may not own any share of a law firm"——非律师不能持股，即禁止外部人士介入。 逐项分析 [A] 阻止律师获利 → 原文是费用高，律师能赚钱； [B] 阻止律师持股 → 原文是 non-lawyers 不能持股，律师可以； [C] 恶化职业道德 → 反对者称这反而保护道德，不是原因； [D] 禁止外部人士介入 → 正确。

entries.title: In this text, the author mainly discusses ___.
entries.text: In this text, the author mainly discusses ___. [A] flawed ownership of America's law firms and its causes. 美国律所所有权的缺陷及其成因。 [B] the factors that help make a successful lawyer in America. 在美国造就成功律师的因素。 [C] a problem in America's legal profession and solutions to it. [D] the role of undergraduate studies in America's legal education. 本科学习在美国法律教育中的作用。 答案 C In this text, the author mainly discusses ___.在本文中，作者主要讨论了___。 [A] flawed ownership of America's law firms and its causes.美国律所所有权的缺陷及其成因。 [B] the factors that help make a successful lawyer in America.在美国造就成功律师的因素。 [C] a problem in America's legal profession and solutions to it. [D] the role of undergraduate studies in America's legal education.本科学习在美国法律教育中的作用。 💡 考场思路全文结构：提出问题（美国法律行业费用高、学生涌入、侵权噩梦）→ 分析两大原因（教育成本、所有权结构）→ 给出改革建议。对应 [C]。 逐项分析 [A] 只讲所有权问题和原因 → 片面，只覆盖第五段； [B] 如何成为成功律师 → 偏离； [C] 法律行业的问题与解决方案 → 正确； [D] 本科作用 → 片面。 核心词汇 implement v. 实施 efficiency n. 效率 innovation n. 创新 restrictive adj. 限制性的

entries.title: The Fundamental Physics Prize is seen as ___.
entries.text: The Fundamental Physics Prize is seen as ___. [A] a symbol of the entrepreneurs' wealth. 企业家财富的象征。 [B] a possible replacement of the Nobel Prizes. 诺贝尔奖可能的一种替代。 [C] a handsome reward for researchers. [D] an example of bankers' investments. 银行家投资的一个例子。 答案 C The Fundamental Physics Prize is seen as ___.基础物理学奖被视为___。 [A] a symbol of the entrepreneurs' wealth.企业家财富的象征。 [B] a possible replacement of the Nobel Prizes.诺贝尔奖可能的一种替代。 [C] a handsome reward for researchers. [D] an example of bankers' investments.银行家投资的一个例子。 💡 考场思路首段：a string of lucrative awards for researchers，300万美元——丰厚的研究者奖励。 逐项分析 [A] 企业家财富象征 → 资助方是互联网企业家，但奖项被看作"给研究者的奖"； [B] 可能替代诺贝尔奖 → 原文 joined the Nobel Prizes，不是 replacement； [C] 给研究者的丰厚奖励 → 正确； [D] 银行家投资 → 原文是 Internet entrepreneurs，不是 bankers。 核心词汇 lucrative adj. 赚钱的/丰厚的 upstart n. 暴发户 prestige n. 声望 perpetuate v. 使永存 legitimate adj. 合理的/合法的 recipients n. 获奖者

entries.title: The critics think that the new awards will most benefit ___.
entries.text: The critics think that the new awards will most benefit ___. [A] the profit-oriented scientists. 以利润为导向的科学家。 [B] the founders of the awards. [C] the achievement-based system. 以成就为基础的制度。 [D] peer-review-led research. 以同行评审为主导的研究。 答案 B The critics think that the new awards will most benefit ___.评论家们认为，新的奖项将使___受益最多。 [A] the profit-oriented scientists.以利润为导向的科学家。 [B] the founders of the awards. [C] the achievement-based system.以成就为基础的制度。 [D] peer-review-led research.以同行评审为主导的研究。 💡 考场思路第二段："The new awards are an exercise in self-promotion for those behind them"——新奖项是幕后推手的自我推销，即让颁奖者（founders）受益。

entries.title: The discovery of the Higgs boson is a typical case which involves ___.
entries.text: The discovery of the Higgs boson is a typical case which involves ___. [A] the joint effort of modern researchers. [B] controversies over the recipients' status. 关于受奖者身份的争议。 [C] the demonstration of research findings. 研究成果的展示。 [D] legitimate concerns over the new prizes. 对新奖项的正当关切。 答案 A The discovery of the Higgs boson is a typical case which involves ___.希格斯玻色子的发现是一个涉及___的典型案例。 [A] the joint effort of modern researchers. [B] controversies over the recipients' status.关于受奖者身份的争议。 [C] the demonstration of research findings.研究成果的展示。 [D] legitimate concerns over the new prizes.对新奖项的正当关切。 💡 考场思路例证题看论点。论点句："the collaborative nature of modern research"——现代研究的协作性质。希格斯玻色子例子就是为了说明这一点。 逐项分析 [A] 现代研究者的共同努力 → 正确，对应 collaborative nature； [B] 获奖者地位争议 → 这是例子的表面； [C] 研究发现展示 → 偏离； [D] 对新奖的合理担忧 → 这是本段主题，不是例子本身要说明的。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 4, which of the following is true of the Nobels?
entries.text: According to Paragraph 4, which of the following is true of the Nobels? [A] History has never cast doubt on them. 历史从未对他们有过质疑。 [B] They are the most representative honor. 它们是最具代表性的荣誉。 [C] Their legitimacy has long been in dispute. 它们的合法性长期存在争议。 [D] Their endurance has done justice to them. 答案 D According to Paragraph 4, which of the following is true of the Nobels?根据第4段，以下哪项对诺贝尔奖来说是正确的？ [A] History has never cast doubt on them.历史从未对他们有过质疑。 [B] They are the most representative honor.它们是最具代表性的荣誉。 [C] Their legitimacy has long been in dispute.它们的合法性长期存在争议。 [D] Their endurance has done justice to them. 💡 考场思路第四段末："Time, rather than intention, has given them legitimacy"——时间赋予了诺贝尔奖合法性。endurance = 时间的考验/持久。 逐项分析 [A] 历史从未怀疑 → 与原文"limit...has long been outgrown"不符； [B] 最具代表性荣誉 → 未提及； [C] 合法性长期受争议 → 与原文相反，时间已赋予其合法性； [D] 时间考验证明了其价值 → 正确，Time has given them legitimacy。

entries.title: The author believes that the new awards are ___.
entries.text: The author believes that the new awards are ___. [A] harmful to the culture of research. 有害于科研文化。 [B] acceptable despite the criticism. [C] subject to undesirable changes. 可能遭受不利的变化。 [D] unworthy of public attention. 不值得公众关注。 答案 B The author believes that the new awards are ___.作者认为，新的奖项是___。 [A] harmful to the culture of research.有害于科研文化。 [B] acceptable despite the criticism. [C] subject to undesirable changes.可能遭受不利的变化。 [D] unworthy of public attention.不值得公众关注。 💡 考场思路末段："It is wise to take such gifts with gratitude and grace"——作者建议心怀感激地接受，即尽管有批评但可以接受。 逐项分析 [A] 有害研究文化 → 这是批评者的观点，作者不这么认为； [B] 尽管有批评仍可接受 → 正确； [C] 易受不良变化影响 → 无中生有； [D] 不值得公众关注 → 与"money and attention come to science is good"相反。 核心词汇 legitimacy n. 合法性 collaborative adj. 协作的 grace n. 优雅 distort v. 扭曲

entries.title: According to Paragraph 1, what is the author's attitude toward the AAAS's report
entries.text: According to Paragraph 1, what is the author's attitude toward the AAAS's report? [A] Critical. [B] Appreciative. 欣赏的；感激的。 [C] Contemptuous. 轻蔑的；鄙视的。 [D] Tolerant. 宽容的。 答案 A According to Paragraph 1, what is the author's attitude toward the AAAS's report?根据第1段，作者对AAAS报告的态度如何？ [A] Critical. [B] Appreciative.欣赏的；感激的。 [C] Contemptuous.轻蔑的；鄙视的。 [D] Tolerant.宽容的。 💡 考场思路第一段：先肯定 deserves praise，接着 "Regrettably...may cause more harm than good"——遗憾地、弊大于利，是批评态度。 逐项分析 [A] 批评的 → 正确，more harm than good 是批评； [B] 欣赏的 → 只看到前半句 deserves praise，忽略转折； [C] 蔑视的 → 程度过重，作者并非 contemptuous； [D] 宽容的 → 不符。 核心词汇 affirm v. 肯定 liberal democracy 自由民主 illiberal adj. 非自由的 presuppose v. 以……为前提 propaganda n. 宣传 set back 阻碍

entries.title: Influential figures in the Congress required that the AAAS report on how to ___.
entries.text: Influential figures in the Congress required that the AAAS report on how to ___. [A] safeguard individuals' rights to education. 保障个人的受教育权。 [B] define the government's role in education. 界定政府在教育中的角色。 [C] retain people's interest in liberal education. 保持人们对通识教育的兴趣。 [D] keep a leading position in liberal education. 答案 D Influential figures in the Congress required that the AAAS report on how to ___.国会中有影响力的人物要求AAAS报告如何___。 [A] safeguard individuals' rights to education.保障个人的受教育权。 [B] define the government's role in education.界定政府在教育中的角色。 [C] retain people's interest in liberal education.保持人们对通识教育的兴趣。 [D] keep a leading position in liberal education. 💡 考场思路第二段："maintain national excellence in humanities and social scientific scholarship and education"——保持国家在人文社科教育领域的卓越地位。excellence = leading position。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 3, the report suggests ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 3, the report suggests ___. [A] an exclusive study of American history. 一项专属的美国历史研究。 [B] a greater emphasis on theoretical subjects. 对理论学科更大的重视。 [C] the application of emerging technologies. [D] funding for the study of foreign languages. 外语研究的经费。 答案 C According to Paragraph 3, the report suggests ___.根据第3段，报告建议___。 [A] an exclusive study of American history.一项专属的美国历史研究。 [B] a greater emphasis on theoretical subjects.对理论学科更大的重视。 [C] the application of emerging technologies. [D] funding for the study of foreign languages.外语研究的经费。 💡 考场思路第三段："encourages the use of new digital technologies"——鼓励使用新数字技术，即应用新兴技术。 逐项分析 [A] 只研究美国历史 → 原文是 stresses the study of history...particularly American history，不是 exclusive； [B] 更强调理论学科 → 无中生有； [C] 应用新兴技术 → 正确； [D] 外语研究经费 → 原文是 greater study of foreign languages，不是 funding。

entries.title: The author implies in Paragraph 5 that professors are ___.
entries.text: The author implies in Paragraph 5 that professors are ___. [A] supportive of free markets. 支持自由市场。 [B] biased against classical liberal ideas. [C] cautious about intellectual investigation. 对智识探究持谨慎态度。 [D] conservative about public policy. 对公共政策持保守态度。 答案 B The author implies in Paragraph 5 that professors are ___.作者在第5段中暗示教授是___。 [A] supportive of free markets.支持自由市场。 [B] biased against classical liberal ideas. [C] cautious about intellectual investigation.对智识探究持谨慎态度。 [D] conservative about public policy.对公共政策持保守态度。 💡 考场思路第五段：教授们把保守或古典自由主义思想（自由市场、自立）描绘为"超出常规、不合法的研究范畴"——即对古典自由主义思想有偏见。

entries.title: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
entries.text: Which of the following would be the best title for the text? [A] Illiberal Education and "The Heart of the Matter". [B] The AAAS's Contribution to Liberal Education. AAAS对通识教育的贡献。 [C] Ways to Grasp "The Heart of the Matter". 把握“问题核心”的途径。 [D] Progressive Policy vs. Liberal Education. 进步政策 vs. 通识教育。 答案 A Which of the following would be the best title for the text?以下哪项是文字的最佳标题？ [A] Illiberal Education and "The Heart of the Matter". [B] The AAAS's Contribution to Liberal Education.AAAS对通识教育的贡献。 [C] Ways to Grasp "The Heart of the Matter".把握“问题核心”的途径。 [D] Progressive Policy vs. Liberal Education.进步政策 vs. 通识教育。 💡 考场思路全文围绕《问题的核心》报告展开，核心批评是"自由教育的非自由本质（illiberal nature of liberal education）"。 逐项分析 [A] 非自由教育与《问题的核心》 → 正确； [B] AAAS对自由教育的贡献 → 作者是批评态度，不是贡献； [C] 理解《问题的核心》的方法 → 偏离； [D] 进步政策 vs 自由教育 → 偏离核心。 核心词汇 citizenry n. 公民群体 curriculum n. 课程 enlighten v. 启发 obscure v. 掩盖

entries.title: 【题目】关于考古遗址如何被发现/定位的科普文章。A和E段已给出，要求从B、C、D、F、G中选出5段填入41-45。
entries.text: 【题目】关于考古遗址如何被发现/定位的科普文章。A和E段已给出，要求从B、C、D、F、G中选出5段填入41-45。 答案 C 【题目】关于考古遗址如何被发现/定位的科普文章。A和E段已给出，要求从B、C、D、F、G中选出5段填入41-45。 匹配依据A段首句"Some archaeological sites have always been easily observable"——但A段是已知位置。41在A之前。C段首句"How do archaeologists know where to find...when there is nothing visible on the surface?"——这是个总起问句，引出全文话题，且 C 段讲"survey and sample"，自然过渡到 A 段讲"有些遗址显眼"。 Part B 选项原文（英汉对照）A–G ASome archaeological sites have always been easily observable—for example, the Parthenon in Athens, Greece; the pyramids of Giza in Egypt; and the megaliths of Stonehenge in southern England. But these sites are exceptions to the norm. Most archaeological sites have been located by means of careful searching, while many others have been discovered by accident. Olduvai Gorge, in Tanzania, was found by a butterfly hunter who literally fell into its deep valley in 1911. Thousands of Aztec artifacts came to light during the digging of the Mexico City subway in the 1970s.有些考古遗址

entries.title: 【题目】关于考古遗址如何被发现/定位的科普文章。A和E段已给出，要求从B、C、D、F、G中选出5段填入41-45。
entries.text: 【题目】关于考古遗址如何被发现/定位的科普文章。A和E段已给出，要求从B、C、D、F、G中选出5段填入41-45。 答案 F 【题目】关于考古遗址如何被发现/定位的科普文章。A和E段已给出，要求从B、C、D、F、G中选出5段填入41-45。 匹配依据A段末讲"many others discovered by accident（偶然发现）"。F段首句"Most archaeological sites, however, are discovered by archaeologists who have set out to look for them."——"however"转折，从偶然发现转到主动寻找（卡特找图坦卡蒙墓、伊文思找米诺斯宫殿），与A段形成对比。 Part B 选项原文（英汉对照）A–G ASome archaeological sites have always been easily observable—for example, the Parthenon in Athens, Greece; the pyramids of Giza in Egypt; and the megaliths of Stonehenge in southern England. But these sites are exceptions to the norm. Most archaeological sites have been located by means of careful searching, while many others have been discovered by accident. Olduvai Gorge, in Tanzania, was found by a butterfly hunter who literally fell into its deep valley in 1911. entries.text: It is also the reason why when we try to describe music with words, all we can do is articulate our reactions to it, and not grasp music itself. It is also the reason why when we try to describe music with words, all we can do is articulate our reactions to it, and not grasp music itself. 这也解释了为什么当我们尝试用语言描述音乐的时候，充其量只能说清楚自己的感受，而无法抓住音乐本身。 采分点① the reason why ……的原因；② try to describe 试图描述；③ articulate our reactions to it 说清我们对它的感受；④ grasp music itself 抓住音乐本身。

entries.text: By all accounts he was a freethinking person, and a courageous one, and I find courage an essential quality for the understanding, let alone the performance, of his works. By all accounts he was a freethinking person, and a courageous one, and I find courage an essential quality for the understanding, let alone the performance, of his works. 总而言之，他是一个思想不受束缚的人，而且是一个富有勇气的人。我认为勇气是理解——更是演奏——其作品不可或缺的品格。 采分点① By all accounts 总而言之/大家都说；② freethinking 思想自由的；③ find sth + 名词宾补 发现某物是……；④ let alone 更不用说。

entries.title: Beethoven's habit of increasing the volume with an extreme intensity and then ab
entries.text: Beethoven's habit of increasing the volume with an extreme intensity and then abruptly following it with a sudden soft passage was only rarely used by composers before him. Beethoven's habit of increasing the volume with an extreme intensity and then abruptly following it with a sudden soft passage was only rarely used by composers before him. 贝多芬惯以超凡的力度加大音响，随后突然进入一个意想不到的柔和乐段。这种手法在他之前的作曲家中极为罕见。 采分点① extreme intensity 极强的力度；② abruptly 突然地；③ soft passage 柔和的乐段；④ rarely 罕见地。

entries.title: Especially significant was his view of freedom, which, for him, was associated w
entries.text: Especially significant was his view of freedom, which, for him, was associated with the rights and responsibilities of the individual: he advocated freedom of thought and of personal expression. Especially significant was his view of freedom, which, for him, was associated with the rights and responsibilities of the individual: he advocated freedom of thought and of personal expression. 尤具深意的是他的自由观，在他看来自由关系到个人的权利与责任：他主张思想自由和个人表达的自由。 采分点① 倒装句 Especially significant was... 尤具深意的是……；② be associated with 与……相关；③ advocate 主张。

entries.text: One could interpret much of the work of Beethoven by saying that suffering is inevitable, but the courage to fight it renders life worth living. One could interpret much of the work of Beethoven by saying that suffering is inevitable, but the courage to fight it renders life worth living. 苦难是不可避免的，但与之抗争的勇气正是生活的意义所在。对贝多芬的诸多作品，我们都可做此解读。 采分点① interpret 解读；② suffering is inevitable 苦难不可避免；③ render life worth living 使生活值得过。
